_comment: Known legacy TCO/comparison tables whose figures were computed at the OLD ₱1,000 licence rate, or which embed implementation cost. They are NOT auto-fixable by regex: each has different assumptions (user counts, term length, whether implementation is included). validate-pricing.mjs WARNS on these and FAILS on anything not listed, so new violations can never hide behind this list. Each must be reworked by hand and removed from this file.
